title: 🎵 "Claude Duet" Reaches India and Three New Countries… An AI Assistant in a Trial Version!
body: 🎵 "Claude Duet" Reaches India and Three New Countries… An AI Assistant in a Trial Version!
Anthropic has announced that its smart assistant "Claude Duet" is reaching India, after being available only in the United States, in a new expansion for one of the most prominent AI assistants.

The list of new markets, in addition to India, includes Indonesia, Brazil, and Japan, where the assistant is now available in a research preview version — an early trial version still under development.

But access is not for everyone yet: the assistant is available only to subscribers of the Pro, Max, and Ultra plans, and eligible users in India can join the waitlist through the Claude website, receiving an email notification when access opens for them.

The standalone "Claude Duet" app has also become available for download to iPhone users through the Apple Store, and to Android users through Google Play, making the assistant a standalone app rather than just a feature inside another app.
The expansion comes at a time when AI companies are competing to reach new markets, and India, with its large population, is a market that cannot be ignored.
Simply put: a new AI assistant opens its doors in four countries at once; would you join its waitlist?
Which AI assistant do you use daily: Claude or another?
